layout.heading: What Is **an SMM Reseller Panel?**
layout.body:
An SMM reseller panel is a platform where you purchase social media marketing services at wholesale rates and sell them to your own clients at a higher price. You act as the business owner. The panel handles all delivery on the backend.

As an [SMMGen](/about-us) reseller, you get access to every service on our platform — followers, likes, views, comments, watch time, members, and more — for Instagram, YouTube, TikTok, Facebook, Telegram, Twitter/X, LinkedIn, and every other supported platform. You set your own prices. You manage your own client relationships. SMMGen processes every order automatically.

The model works because the [SMM Panel](/) industry operates at wholesale scale. SMMGen maintains the delivery infrastructure, provider relationships, and technical systems. You focus on acquiring clients and growing your business.

layout.heading: How the **SMMGen Reseller Model Works**
layout.body:
The business model is simple. Here is exactly how it operates from your side.

You purchase services from SMMGen at our wholesale panel prices. You charge your clients a higher price for those same services. The difference is your profit.

Example: SMMGen charges $0.80 per 1,000 Instagram followers on a standard package. You charge your client $2.50 per 1,000. Your margin on that order is $1.70 per 1,000 units, or a 212% markup. Multiply that across hundreds of orders per month and you have a real income stream.

You are not limited to one service or one client. SMMGen's dashboard handles multiple simultaneous orders. The API lets you connect your own website or ordering system so clients can place orders directly without coming to you manually.

The key advantage of the reseller model is that you own the client relationship. You set your prices. You choose which services to offer. You build your own brand. SMMGen stays in the background handling delivery.

cards.body: Agencies managing multiple client accounts use SMMGen to deliver growth results efficiently. Instead of building delivery infrastructure from scratch, you use SMMGen as your backend. The API integrates into your existing workflow. Bulk orders are processed automatically. You report results to clients without touching each order manually.

cards.title: Content Creators and Influencers
cards.body: Creators with an audience often get asked by their followers where they buy services. Becoming an SMMGen reseller lets you monetize that question. You refer clients through your own branded offering. They pay you. You fulfill through SMMGen.

cards.title: Students and First-Time Entrepreneurs
cards.body: The SMMGen reseller panel requires no coding skills, no technical background, and no large upfront investment. You can start with a small initial deposit and test with your first few clients before scaling. The barrier to entry is low. The potential to scale is high.

cards.title: Existing SMM Panel Owners
cards.body: If you already run an SMM panel and need a reliable upstream provider, SMMGen's API connects directly to your panel's backend. Your clients place orders on your panel. SMMGen fulfills them on ours. You maintain full control of your front end while relying on our infrastructure for delivery.

layout.heading: How to Start Reselling with SMMGen — **Step by Step**
layout.intro: Getting started takes less than 10 minutes. Follow these steps exactly.

cards.title: Create Your Free SMMGen Account
cards.body: Go to [smmgen.com/signup](https://my.smmgen.com/signup) and register with your email address. Account creation is free and takes under two minutes. You get immediate access to the full dashboard including the service catalog, pricing, and API documentation.

cards.title: Add Funds to Your Balance
cards.body: Click "Add Funds" inside your dashboard. SMMGen accepts PayPal, Visa, Mastercard, Bitcoin, Ethereum, USDT, and local payment options worldwide. Add whatever amount you want to start with. There is no minimum deposit requirement beyond the cost of your first order.

cards.title: Study the Service Catalog
cards.body: Before you approach clients, spend time in the catalog. Understand which services are available, what the delivery times are, and what our wholesale prices look like. This gives you the information you need to set your client-facing prices with confidence. Bookmark services that fit your target market. If you are working with Instagram-focused clients, explore every service on the Instagram SMM panel page. If your clients need YouTube growth, explore the YouTube SMM panel page.

cards.title: Set Your Prices and Find Clients
cards.body: Decide how much to charge your clients for each service. A common approach is to mark up 2x to 3x the wholesale cost for standard services and 4x to 5x for premium or high-retention services where clients are less price-sensitive. Your first clients are usually in your existing network: business owners you know, creators you follow, local shops with social media accounts. Once you have a few successful deliveries, word-of-mouth and online marketing take over.

icon.alt: Set Your Prices and Find Clients

cards.title: Place Orders and Track Delivery
cards.body: When a client orders from you, log in to SMMGen, find the service, paste the client's public profile or post link, and submit the order. Delivery starts automatically. Monitor the status inside your dashboard and update your client when complete. Once you are handling volume, connect the SMM panel API to automate this entire process.

layout.heading: What Can **You Earn as an SMMGen Reseller?**
layout.intro: Earnings depend on three factors: the services you sell, the prices you charge, and the volume of clients you serve. There is no ceiling on what a reseller can earn. The model scales with effort.

cards.title: Building Recurring Revenue
cards.body:
The most profitable resellers do not rely on one-time orders. They build recurring relationships with clients who reorder consistently. A business page that buys 500 Instagram followers this month will likely buy again next month. A creator that orders TikTok views for one video will want the same for the next.
Focus on client retention, not just client acquisition. Recurring revenue from 20 steady clients beats chasing 100 one-time orders every month.

layout.heading: Reseller vs. White **Label vs. Wholesale — What Is the Difference?**
layout.intro: Many resellers eventually want more than just placing orders through our dashboard. Here is how SMMGen's different options compare.
layout.body: Most resellers start with the standard reseller model, move to white label once they have a steady client base, and explore wholesale pricing as volume grows.

cards.title: SMM Reseller Panel
cards.body: You use SMMGen's dashboard to place orders on behalf of your clients. You pay our wholesale rates and charge your clients whatever you choose. This is the fastest way to start.

cards.title: White Label SMM Panel
cards.body: You get a fully branded version of an SMM panel operating under your own domain name and brand identity. Your clients see your brand, not SMMGen. You set all prices inside the panel. Clients can log in and order directly without going through you manually. Full details are on the [white label SMM panel page](/white-label-smm-panel).

cards.title: Wholesale SMM Panel
cards.body: For very high-volume buyers who want the deepest possible discounts across bulk orders. This is suited to resellers handling thousands of orders per month. Full details are on the [wholesale SMM panel page](/wholesale-smm-panel).

layout.heading: Frequently Asked Questions About the **SMMGen Reseller Panel**

faq.question: What is an SMM reseller panel?
faq.answer: An SMM reseller panel is a platform where you buy social media services at wholesale prices and resell them to your own clients at a higher price. SMMGen's reseller panel gives you access to 9,000+ services across every major platform. You set your own prices and keep the margin. SMMGen handles all delivery automatically.

faq.question: How do I start reselling SMM services with SMMGen?
faq.answer: Create a free account at smmgen.com/signup, add funds using any supported payment method, study the service catalog, set your client-facing prices, and start placing orders on your clients' behalf. The process takes less than 10 minutes to set up. No technical skills are required to begin.

faq.question: How much profit can I make as an SMM reseller?
faq.answer: Margins vary by service but typically range from 150% to 700% above SMMGen's wholesale cost. A reseller charging $3.00 per 1,000 Instagram followers while paying $0.80 wholesale earns a 275% margin on that service. Earnings scale with the number of clients you serve and how consistently they reorder.

faq.question: Do I need technical skills to become an SMM reseller?
faq.answer: No. The standard reseller model requires no coding or technical knowledge. You log in, browse services, place orders, and track delivery through the dashboard. For resellers who want to automate, the SMM panel API is available. But API use is optional, not required.

faq.question: What is the minimum deposit to start reselling on SMMGen?
faq.answer: There is no stated minimum deposit. You add whatever amount covers your first order. Many resellers start with $10 to $20 to test a few services before scaling. The low entry point means you can verify delivery quality before committing larger amounts.

faq.question: Can I use SMMGen to power my own SMM panel website?
faq.answer: Yes. SMMGen's API connects directly to other panel systems. If you have your own panel website, point it to SMMGen's API for order fulfillment. Your clients order on your site. SMMGen delivers on the backend. For a fully branded experience without building your own site, see the white label SMM panel option.

faq.question: Does SMMGen offer refunds if a reseller order fails to deliver?
faq.answer: Yes. SMMGen's published refund policy covers failed or incomplete orders. If a service does not deliver as described, you are eligible for a refund or account credit. Raise a support ticket from your dashboard to initiate a claim.
